annotations.title: Upay Calculator (classical remedies from the birth chart)

description: Classical remedies (upay) chosen from the birth chart: finds the weak / afflicted grahas and the running Mahadasha-Antardasha, and returns three remedies from Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra Ch.84 (graha shanti) — Vedic mantra with jap count, day, offering, daan — each with its granth reference. Optionally pass one graha to get that planet's remedies. Remedies are taken from the texts, not written by an AI.

grah.description: Optional: get remedies for this graha (Surya, Chandra, Mangal, Budh, Guru, Shukra, Shani, Rahu, Ketu)

latitude.description: Birthplace latitude in decimal degrees (e.g. New Delhi 28.6139)

longitude.description: Birthplace longitude in decimal degrees (e.g. New Delhi 77.2090)

time.description: Time of birth, 24-hour HH:MM (local time at birthplace). 12:00 is the conventional value when the exact time is unknown.

timezone.description: UTC offset in hours at birth (India = 5.5)
